seoDescription: Your space is already deciding how you live. Book a free fit call, or a one hour Design Jumpstart, with Petrina Salema in Vienna.
hook: Your space is already deciding how you live. Stop decorating around a life you didn't choose. Shape the room that holds how you want to rest, gather, and think.

projectOffer.title: Full project
projectOffer.body: A redesign of how a home or room operates, from layout and material to guest flow and daily rituals.
projectOffer.note: I take on a few residences a year, in Vienna, abroad, and remotely.
projectOffer.finance: Projects are billed in stages, deposit to final. If a payment plan would help, say so on the call.

jumpstartOffer.title: Design Jumpstart
jumpstartOffer.body: One hour session. Get a clear point of view on the change that would matter most, and your next step.
